description: This Java class defines configuration properties for connecting to an Infinispan cache via Hotrod, including methods to set properties for SASL authentication and cluster configuration.

classes.name: InfinispanRemoteConfigurationProperties
classes.description: A class extending ConfigurationProperties that encapsulates configuration settings for an Infinispan remote cache connection.

methods.name: getConfigurationBuilder
methods.description: Returns a ConfigurationBuilder initialized with current properties for further customization.

methods.name: setSaslProperties
methods.description: Sets SASL-related properties for authentication by updating the internal properties map.

methods.name: setCluster
methods.description: Sets cluster-related properties in the internal configuration for cluster setup.
